text:
olivia: quick design question: Console preview for a runtime flag change 1should we render the final routing table (cohort weights + fallbacks) or only the delta/override? ops wants to be sure the preview matches live behavior.
sam: show both compactly. delta is useful for quick scan but people will ask "how much did traffic shift" so final table heatmap is needed.
rita: +1. add a confidence/footnote: previews are based on recent telemetry samples, not perfect. show `as_of` timestamp and an estimated error band.
leo: operational concern: computed preview can be expensive for big configs (thousands of cohorts). we should provide two modes: cheap preview (deterministic merge of rules) and "simulate with traffic" which runs heavier sampling/simulation. cheap mode should be default.
ux-zoe: UI notes: keep the card small. left column: summary badges (changed cohorts, max shift %), middle: mini-heatmap (final), right: small collapsible raw override. add "Explain" link per cohort that reveals a short bullet list of contributing rules.
olivia: perfect. auditors asked for an "apply intent" that records user, reason, preview snapshot, and required confirmations. API should return an id. we can use that id to tie audit entries and runbook links.
sam: API sketch: POST /v1/apply_intents -> { "id": "string", "status": "string" } then clients GET /v1/apply_intents/:id. include `telemetry_snapshot_id` so results are reproducible.
rita: also add server headers for cache info: `X-Preview-Cache: HIT|MISS` and `X-Preview-Freshness: seconds` so Console knows how stale the preview is.
leo: rate limit preview endpoints for production: 5/min/org by default. implement a short in-memory cache TTL=30s for computed previews. simulate jobs go to queue with `simulate-with-traffic` flag.
ops-bot: ALERT: preflight analysis for apply 6150001234 1found 3 tenants that would change >40% traffic. Suggest canary for those tenants. Runbook: /runbooks/large-config-shift.
ux-zoe: if preflight flags large shift, show blocking modal with: highlighted tenants, quick chart, checkbox "I accept risk" and `Confirm and create apply intent`. require typed confirmation for >50% shifts.
olivia: legal/security wants the preview->apply flow to write an audit event with the `apply_intent_id` and the exact preview payload. audit-bot will pick it up.
audit-bot: AUDIT: apply_intent created id=ai_20260323_001 user=olivia org=redwood-test reason="adjust latency pools" preview_snapshot=ts_20260323_1012
sam: one more metric: expose `preview_compute_cost` (est CPU ms) and `previews_per_apply` per-org so PM can see if previews are used effectively.
rita: we should cap lineage details length: return up to 6 lines of explanation per cohort (strings only). avoid dumping evaluator stack.
leo: implement fast-path merge on read so most previews are cheap. enqueue heavy sim only if `simulate_with_traffic=true`.
deploy-bot: deploy started: platform-api v3-preview -> canary (sha: b4d5c6) by @sam :rocket:
olivia: thanks all, I'll file a tiny Console PR to show `X-Preview-Freshness` and wire the explain popover. scheduling follow-up sync tomorrow. :calendar:
